name: Seneca College
description: Seneca College in Canada, which opened its doors in 1967, started its education life in a renovated factory, the area became Seneca's first campus a year later and became known as the Newnham Campus. In the same year, the Buttonville Campus for Aviation Programs was also activated and in 1971 the King Campus started training within Seneca. The York campuses were opened in 1999 and the Markham campuses in 2005. Apart from these, education continues at small campuses such as Newmarket, Scarborough, Yorkgate and Vaughan.
